rulesStrings.li:
questDescription->A Bloodfiend named [asker_nameDef] is looking for a safe place for [asker_possessive] Family to gather: [bloodfiendCountMinusOne] other [bloodfiendSingOrPlural] of the same blood. [asker_pronoun] is asking to hold the gathering at [map_definite].

If you accept, [bloodfiendCount] Bloodfiends will arrive at [map_definite] from different directions. They will spend several hours together before departing, and give you your reward before they leave.

You may betray them and attack. A captured Bloodfiend can be forced to Embrace one of your colonists.
bloodfiendsArriveLetterText->The [bloodfiendCount] Bloodfiends are arriving at [map_definite] from different directions. They will gather in the colony.
successLetterText->The Bloodfiends have finished their gathering and will now give you your reward.
raidArrivedLetterText->A group of Bloodfiend hunters from [enemyFaction_name] are approaching!\n\nThey will attack the gathered Bloodfiends as well as those who hosted them.
